enabled.name: Enable D&D Light theme
enabled.hint: Master switch. When off, Carolingian UI falls back to its own colour theme and nothing in this module applies.

forceLightScheme.name: Force light color scheme
forceLightScheme.hint: Sets this client's Foundry color scheme to light for both applications and interface. This is a light theme, and Carolingian UI keys most of its palette off Foundry's light/dark classes, so leaving the client on dark will look wrong. Affects only you, and you can change it back in Foundry's own settings.

restoreRarityColors.name: Restore PF2e rarity colors
restoreRarityColors.hint: Puts back Pathfinder 2e's own item rarity and proficiency rank colors (uncommon #98513d, rare #002664, unique #54166e), which Carolingian UI replaces with washed-out variants. Also tints item names in inventory and spell lists by rarity.

parchmentSheets.name: Parchment sheets and windows
parchmentSheets.hint: Applies the D&D parchment background, gold borders and maroon tabs to windows and character sheets. Turn off to keep the light color palette but leave Carolingian UI's flat window styling alone.

notifications.missingCrlngn: Carolingian UI — D&D Light needs the Carolingian UI module (crlngn-ui) installed and active. Nothing will be themed until it is.
notifications.dorakoActive: Carolingian UI — D&D Light: PF2e Dorako UI is also active. Both modules restyle the same elements and will conflict. Disable PF2e Dorako UI — this module already reproduces its D&D light palette.
